description: People an automation answered in the last `days` (default 7), newest first: their handle, the keyword they used, the post they asked under, and the email they gave, if any. Filter by account, keyword or has_email. opted_out is true when the person sent STOP; never contact them. Never message a lead unless the user asks. Needs inbox access.

days.description: How many days back. Default 7, up to 90.

has_email.description: true: only people who gave an email. false: only people who did not.

keyword.description: Only people who used this keyword, like LINK.

limit.description: How many people. Default 50, up to 200.

name: sprkly_list_leads
title: List leads
